content:
aaron: Hey all 11 quick thought 11 instead of a big secret santa this year, anyone down for a tiny gratitude chain? You reply with one thing youre grateful for this year and tag someone else to keep it going. Low pressure, bring your gifs. :sparkles:

mei: Love this. Grateful for the team sticking through the runtime rollouts. tagging @sofia to continue! :heart:

sofia: Grateful for the snacks in the office kitchen and the weirdly perfect playlist for late deploys. tagging @carter :headphones: :cookie:

carter: Grateful for coffee that actually tastes like coffee and for everyone who answers odd midnight pings. tagging @rishi :coffee:

rishi: Grateful for having a sandbox where we can try dumb experiments and for the infra folks making them safe. tagging @aaron :robot_face:

people-ops-bot: Quick note from people-ops: if anyone wants a physical or digital token mailed (stickers, cozy socks, or a little treat), fill the RSVP form: https://forms.example.com/winter-token by Fri EOD.

aaron: Also 11small poll: would people prefer a 10-min midday gratitude call (15:00 PST) or an evening 20-min cocoa chat (20:00 CET)? React with :sunny: for midday, :crescent_moon: for evening.

mei: :sunny: works for me.

sofia: :crescent_moon: but happy either.

carter: :sunny: (short and sweet)

ops-elaine: I can set up both if folks want flexibility. People-ops can also ship a tiny postcard if you put an address in the form.

rishi: Suggestion: on the call we each bring one two-sentence holiday fail story. Quick laughs. :grin:

aaron: Love it. Whoever gets the funniest fail gets a $10 coffee voucher (people-ops approved?): @ops-elaine?

ops-elaine: Approved. :thumbsup: $10 vouchers x3 for the laughter winners. Ill post invites after the form closes.

sofia: Also hijacking the chain for a tiny kudos: @mei pair-programmed the fix that saved my demo last week. Big thanks. :trophy:

mei: aaah stop you! Team effort. :blush:

carter: Can we put a little #gratitude thread summary in the #all-hands slack after? Good vibes for the pan-company message.

aaron: Yep I can collect 5–6 quotes and share. If you dont want your name used, say so.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: token form closes Fri 17:00 local.

rishi: one last tiny thing 11 whos in for doing a collaborative playlist? Drop one favorite song below + mood. Ill stitch it into a "cozy dev" playlist.

sofia: "Winter Morning" 11 mellow.

mei: "Electric java" 11 upbeat.

carter: "Holiday bug" 11 ironic name.

aaron: Thanks everyone. This was faster than email and way warmer. Happy almost-holidays :evergreen_tree: 

ops-elaine: Calendar invites for both slots sent. If you got a conflict, opt out on the event.
